chunks: “When it is the Day of qiyamah, a caller will call out: ‘O creation, be silent, for Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم will speak to you.’ So the creation will fall silent. Then the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم will stand and say: ‘O assembly of creation, whoever has a favor, a kindness, or a good deed with me, let him stand so that I may recompense him.’”

Then they will say: ‘By our fathers and our mothers, what favor, what kindness, and what good deed do we have? Rather, the favor, the kindness, and the good deed belong to Allah and His Messenger over all creation.’

So he will say to them: ‘Rather, whoever gave shelter to anyone from my Ahl al-Bayt, or treated them kindly, or clothed them from nakedness, or fed their hungry one, let him stand so that I may recompense him.’

Then some people who did that will stand, and the call will come from Allah عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: ‘O Muhammad, O My Beloved, I have placed their recompense with you, so settle them in Jannah wherever you wish.’
He said: So he will settle them in al-Wasilah, where they will not be veiled from Muhammad and his Ahl al-Bayt, may the blessings of Allah be upon them all.

key_terms.الْخَلَائِقُ: all created beings gathered for judgment
key_terms.الْوَسِيلَةِ: a lofty station of nearness in Paradise
key_terms.مَعْرُوفٌ: a good deed, kindness, or benefaction
key_terms.يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection and final reckoning

ai.seo_question: What is the reward on the Day of Judgment for those who helped the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a scene on the Day of Judgment in which the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم publicly honors those who showed kindness and support to his Ahl al-Bayt. It emphasizes the عظيمة status of serving the family of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and shows that such acts are rewarded with nearness in Jannah. The report also highlights the Prophet’s role in recompense and the elevated station of al-Wasilah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1727 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"When it is the Day of Judgment, a caller will announce, 'O creation, remain silent, for Muhammad wishes to address you.' Then all creation will fall silent.
The Prophet (sw), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, will stand and say: 'O assembly of creation, whoever has done a favor, shown kindness, or extended generosity to me, let them now stand so that I may repay them.'
The people will respond: 'By our fathers and mothers, what favor, kindness, or generosity do we have toward you? Indeed, the favor, kindness, and generosity are yours and Allah’s (swt) upon all creation.'
He (sw) will say to them: 'Indeed, whoever sheltered anyone from my household, treated them kindly, clothed them when they were unclothed, or fed them when they were hungry, let them stand so I may repay them.'
Then some people who have done these deeds will rise. A call will come from Allah (swt), Exalted and Glorified, saying, 'O Muhammad (sw), O My Beloved, I have made their recompense yours. Admit them into Paradise wherever you wish.'
The Prophet (sw) will then settle them in al-Waseela (a station of nearness to Allah (swt)) where they will not be veiled from Muhammad (sw) and his household (as). Blessings of Allah (swt) be upon them all."
